438211.name: Ledbury Jewish Centre
438211.note: The Canadian Jewish News on CrownHeights.info, 7 Mar 2007 ('Chabad on the Avenue one of 4 new in Toronto'): Chabad on the Avenue 'is one of just four new Chabad centres that have opened in recent months': Rabbi Menachem and Chana Gansburg 'have been on Avenue Road in a 6,000-square-foot former restaurant ... since December', reaching out to the area bounded by Wilson Avenue, Eglinton Avenue, Yonge Street and the Allen Road (Ledbury Park). It became the Family Shul, which bought a church in 2012 (CrownHeights.info, 13 Oct 2012). Its chabad.org listing went up 23 Oct 2006.

440133.name: Chabad of Downtown Toronto
440133.note: The Canadian Jewish News on CrownHeights.info, 7 Mar 2007 ('Chabad on the Avenue one of 4 new in Toronto'): Chabad on the Avenue 'is one of just four new Chabad centres that have opened in recent months'; among them 'Chabad Lubavitch of Downtown Toronto (jewishdt.com), run by Rabbi Mendel Chaikin and his wife Chanie out of their Queen's Quay condo'. Its chabad.org listing went up 30 Oct 2006.

449787.name: Uptown Chabad Lubavitch
449787.note: The Canadian Jewish News on CrownHeights.info, 7 Mar 2007 ('Chabad on the Avenue one of 4 new in Toronto'): Chabad on the Avenue 'is one of just four new Chabad centres that have opened in recent months'; among them 'Rabbi Moshe and Yehudis Steiner at Uptown Chabad Lubavitch (uptownchabad.com)', in Bathurst Manor, operating out of their home. Its chabad.org listing went up 28 Nov 2006.

439219.name: Rohr Chabad Jewish Student Centre at York University
439219.note: The Canadian Jewish News on CrownHeights.info, 7 Mar 2007 ('Chabad on the Avenue one of 4 new in Toronto'): Chabad on the Avenue 'is one of just four new Chabad centres that have opened in recent months'; among them: 'York University also has a new Chabad, a student club run by former York student Vidal Bekerman ... and his wife Chanah Leah Medina'. Its chabad.org listing went up 26 Oct 2006.

533758.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of Danforth Beaches
533758.note: The Canadian Jewish News on CrownHeights.info, 7 Mar 2007: 'plans are in the works to open one in the Beach area as well' (Toronto's Beaches). Its chabad.org listing went up 28 June 2007 (Rabbi Sholom Lezell).

698452.name: The Rohr Chabad Centre for Jewish Life
698452.note: Lubavitch.com on CrownHeights.info, 29 Nov 2018 ('Chabad Waterloo Celebrates Ten'): 'Rivky, her husband Moishy, and their infant son arrived in Waterloo in 2008', and on their first Shabbat hosted ten students from Wilfrid Laurier and the University of Waterloo. Its chabad.org listing went up 3 Dec 2008.

1848654.name: Chabad of Guelph
1848654.note: Lubavitch.com on CrownHeights.info, 1 Aug 2022: 'In 2012, Jeff renovated a building his company owned (just down the road from the Veterinary College) and Chabad of Guelph was born' (Rabbi Raphi Steiner). Its chabad.org listing went up 4 May 2012.

6696249.name: Chabad Collingwood
6696249.note: CrownHeights.info, 1 Aug 2025 ('New Chabad Center to Collingwood'): Rabbi Berel and Sara Shur 'have been traveling to Collingwood over the past several months'; 'At the end of August, the Shurs will move down permanently to Collingwood, officially establishing Chabad there.' They were among the new shluchim grants of April 2025. Its chabad.org listing went up 1 Jan 2025.

6817840.name: Chabad Center for Jewish Life and Learning of London Ontario
6817840.note: CrownHeights.info, 9 Apr 2025 ('35 New Shluchim Receive Grants'): 'Rabbi Mendel & Mrs. Chani Gurkow - Chabad of London, Ontario, Canada'. Its chabad.org listing went up 24 Apr 2025.

5567381.name: Chabad of Etobicoke
5567381.note: Anash.org, 28 Aug 2022 (read through Firecrawl): Rabbi Duni and Chaya Blotner 'are moving out this week, Hey Elul - Sept 1st, to establish Chabad of Etobicoke, Ontario', brought by Rabbi Zalmen Aharon Grossbaum; 'Etobicoke has surprisingly never had its own Synagogue or other Jewish Establishment.' Its chabad.org listing went up 20 July 2022.
